chunks: He said: 'Do you see? When we took refuge by the rock, indeed I forgot the fish; and what made me forget it was Satan, who caused me to forget to mention it, and it took its course into the sea — a wonder.'
ai.seo_question: Who caused the Prophet's companion to forget the fish in Surah Al-Kahf?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse is pivotal as it marks the moment of separation between Khidr (the servant of God) and Musa (the Prophet), where the fish's revival and escape into the sea served as the divine sign (Ayah) for Musa to begin his journey of spiritual learning. The mention of Satan causing the forgetfulness highlights the human susceptibility to distraction even in moments of divine proximity, emphasizing the need for mindfulness (Taqwa) in seeking knowledge.
